status: pre-registered before any DEV-023 compression command
scope: existing public dev, stratified extension; not a holdout; warm cache; one machine

text.note: 81.55 MB (77.8 MiB) < 128 MiB: the 128 MiB cap and the 1 GiB reference may give the same layout

cap_orders: round r uses frame_limits rotated left by r, so each limit takes positions 1..4 once
operation_order: round 0 and 2: fresh then append; round 1 and 3: append then fresh
parent_preparation: per unit and cap, once: seed pack + verify, explicit pack + verify, payload-compare; timed and reported separately; parents never replaced by repeat outputs
plan_and_codec: single group, Zstd 9, no dictionary, redundancy off; seed and explicit use the same concrete plan
after_every_encode: append: parent SHA unchanged, parent is a byte prefix, old plaintext recompressed == 0, old archive bytes read/copied == parent size
repeat outputs for the same unit/cap/operation have one SHA

access_profile.name: read/decode diagnostic (whole archive read + parse + target frame decode + byte check; no file written)
access_profile.runs: after verify, for every repeat output

fault_profile.runs: first output of each unit/cap/operation; later outputs with the same SHA reuse it (marked)
fault_profile.condition: header and index intact; not index damage or missing volumes

execution.host: India vps-in1 via in-long-task, exclusive mode (user granted full resources 2026-11-25)
one compression command at a time; measured child pinned to one CPU

cache: each command input pre-read; verify before access; no global cache dropping
stop_conditions: any correctness/safety assertion, parent change, input hash mismatch: stop and keep evidence
analysis: per class / actual ratio / cap: size and change vs same-round 1 GiB
encode wall min/median/max, same-round pair ratios
read/decode diagnostic sample paths, decoded bytes, median and p95
append vs fresh: wall, final size, old archive bytes, old plaintext recompressed, parent cost
fault: detected, wrong bytes accepted, recoverable / unrecoverable bytes
